experiment.source: OpenStreetMap geometry / synthetic demand / generated signal plans
experiment.signal_method: One demand-weighted green split candidate. Same 90-second cycle, phase states/order and yellow durations; minimum green 10 s. Not an optimum or a field-safe plan.
experiment.vehicle_types: 92% car, 4% bus-shaped, 4% truck-shaped. All passenger class permissions; no scheduled transit service.
experiment.scope: No pedestrian simulation or pedestrian clearance validation. OSM lane attributes and signal topology not field verified. Teleport disabled. One-seed visualization experiment.

source.name: 대구 범어네거리 주변
source.scope: Road/building geometry from OSM. Demand, signal plans, missing road attributes and default building heights are assumptions. No field calibration.
